"""

	Version: 1.0.0
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version
	"""
	
	self.custom.initialPapoDateTime = system.date.now()

"""
	Section button onClick - trigger accordion toggle.
	
	Version: 1.1.0
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.1.0 - Dynamic, hierarchy-independent
	"""
	
	# Extract section index from component name
	sectionIndex = int(self.meta.name.replace("Section", ""))
	
	# Trigger accordion toggle on root
	self.view.getChild("root").toggleFlexRoot(sectionIndex)
